documentation.sets: Set id -> name, colours, pieces (unique ids from unique_gear) and tiers. A piece counts while it sits in the player's attribute snapshot (worn in its intended slot, not broken, not above the player's level). Each unique counts once.
documentation.tiers: pieces = pieces needed; text = the tooltip line; grants = gear attributes added to the wearer's snapshot while the tier is active (values in the attribute's own units, 1.0 = 100%)
documentation.riptide: Shared riptide tuning: hover friction is the extra per-tick horizontal speed multiplier during the hover, vertical damping the per-tick vertical one; the shock cone spans shockConeAhead blocks ahead of the player to shockConeBehind blocks behind, widening to shockConeRadius; contactInflate grows the box that finds dash contacts by that many blocks per side; a dash that hits a wall ends only once its horizontal speed is below stallSpeed blocks per tick, and never in its first launchGraceTicks ticks
documentation.lightning: Shared lightning tuning: chainRange = how far a channeling strike jumps to the next enemy; throwing a trident with the lightning dash grant turns the thrower into lightning for formDurationTicks, during which each tap of a movement key sends them dashDistance blocks that way as a bolt of lightning, taking dashTravelTicks, striking enemies within dashWidth of the path, then waiting dashCooldownTicks after reappearing before the next dash. Left click is Arc Lash: arcLashBolts spinning lightning bolts thrown out evenly across arcLashConeAngle degrees either side of the look, flying arcLashSpeed blocks a tick for up to arcLashRange, striking each enemy they pass through (once per throw) for arcLashDamage of the thrower's attack damage at the throw and calling a channeling strike (vanilla lightning) down on it for arcLashStrikeDamage of a channeling strike's damage, once per arcLashCooldownTicks. Right click is Lightning Rod: marks the enemy aimed at within rodRange (once per rodCooldownTicks); a dash within rodLockAngle degrees of the target locks on, running through it and on for rodOvershoot of a dash, and strikes it for rodDamageMultiplier of the dash damage. Middle click is Thunderstrike: ends the form with a giant bolt on the player striking every enemy within thunderRadius (across) for the thrower's attack damage times thunderDamagePerSecond per second of form left

tiers.text: Riptide pierces through enemies and deals 100% more damage.
Riptide releases a shock cone, striking enemies from 2 blocks ahead of you to a 4-block radius 3 blocks behind you.
While dashing, a storm shrouds you: you hover briefly after each dash, take 75% less damage, and lightning strikes every enemy your dash or its shock cone hits for 5x damage (15x if chilled).
Channeling strikes deal 100% more damage and chain to 2 more enemies within 6 blocks.
Your thrown trident pierces up to 3 enemies and calls a channeling strike down on each one it passes through.

Throwing your trident turns you into lightning for 10 seconds. During lightning form, using movement keys causes you to dash through enemies for 10% channeling damage, and left clicking releases a fan of arc lightning outwards. You can also mark a single enemy with a lightning rod for increased damage by right clicking them, and middle click (pick block) releases a devastating thunderbolt attack centered on you, dealing more damage the more lightning strikes you land while in lightning form.
